{"metadata":{"description":"dsh cf tunnel ui with token/email verify","id":"gh:1335832899","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-cftunnel","slug":"weicy98/dsh-cftunnel","topics":["dsh-plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"dsh cf tunnel ui with token/email verify"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-cftunnel"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"A DeepSeek Harness bundle plugin that runs a Cloudflare Tunnel to expose the local web GUI (`http://"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"127.0.0.1:3080`) on the public internet."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"**Install the plugin, open Settings, type your Cloudflare info, click Connect.** `cloudflared` is do"},{"id":"p5s2","text":"wnloaded and managed by the plugin itself — no manual install, no package manager, no restart."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Quick start"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"1. **Install** — one command:"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"2. **Restart `dsh web`**, open **Settings → Cloudflare Tunnel**.
3. **Pick a mode, fill in your Clou"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"dflare info, click Connect.** Copy the access URL (it embeds a token on first use) and share it."},{"id":"p10s1","text":"> The first Connect downloads `cloudflared` (~40 MB) once — on slow networks this can take several m"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"inutes; the Settings panel shows a progress bar while it downloads."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## Modes"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"Pick the mode that matches what you have:"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"| Mode | Inputs | URL | Use when |"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"## How it works, end to end"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"1. The Settings section shows a mode picker (Quick / Tunnel token / API token) and a **Connect** but"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"ton.
2. On Connect the plugin first **self-provisions `cloudflared`** — if `$DSH_HOME/cloudflared/cl"},{"id":"p16s3","text":"oudflared` is missing it downloads the official GitHub release asset for your platform, extracts it,"},{"id":"p16s4","text":" and caches it.
3. It starts the tunnel:
- **Quick**: `cloudflared tunnel --url http://127.0.0.1:<pr"},{"id":"p16s5","text":"oxyPort>` → random `https://<name>.trycloudflare.com`.
- **Token**: `cloudflared tunnel run` with a "},{"id":"p16s6","text":"remotely-managed token (routing/ingress configured in the Zero Trust dashboard).
- **API**: create t"},{"id":"p16s7","text":"he tunnel + ingress + DNS CNAME through the Cloudflare HTTP API, then `cloudflared tunnel run` with "},{"id":"p16s8","text":"the returned token (no `cert.pem`, no local config.yml).
4. All tunnel traffic flows through a **loo"},{"id":"p16s9","text":"pback reverse proxy** (`127.0.0.1:<proxyPort>`) that rewrites the Host header to loopback and drops "},{"id":"p16s10","text":"Origin, so the harness trust fence accepts every request — privileged methods included. Access-token"},{"id":"p16s11","text":" verification (default on) and optional Cloudflare Access email OTP gate the proxy.
5. **Secrets** ("},{"id":"p16s12","text":"API token, tunnel token, proxy access token) live in the harness credential store (`~/.dsh/.credenti"},{"id":"p16s13","text":"als.yaml`); **non-secret preferences** (mode, hostname, tunnel name, account/zone ids, email-OTP set"},{"id":"p16s14","text":"tings) live in a `cloudflare-tunnel` settings namespace (`~/.dsh/settings.yaml`) and prefill the for"},{"id":"p16s15","text":"loudflare-tunnel` settings namespace (`~/.dsh/settings.yaml`) and prefill the form on the next open."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"## Security model (important)"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"All tunnel traffic goes through a **loopback reverse proxy** (`127.0.0.1:<proxyPort>`) that rewrites"},{"id":"p18s2","text":" requests to look loopback (Host → `127.0.0.1:<port>`, Origin dropped). The harness trust fence ther"},{"id":"p18s3","text":"efore accepts them fully — **privileged methods included** — so a remote visitor gets the complete l"},{"id":"p18s4","text":"em fully — **privileged methods included** — so a remote visitor gets the complete local experience."},{"id":"p19s1","text":"The proxy binds `127.0.0.1` only; its sole entry point is `cloudflared` (Cloudflare edge). Two indep"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"endent gates sit in front of it:"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"- **Access token (default ON, `proxyAuth: 'token'`)**: every request must carry the token — sent onc"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"e as `?token=…` (the proxy then plants an `HttpOnly; Secure` cookie), or as the cookie afterwards. T"},{"id":"p20s3","text":"he UI shows the ready-to-share access URL and can toggle the gate live.
- **Cloudflare Access email "},{"id":"p20s4","text":"OTP (optional, `accessPolicy: 'emailOtp'`)**: edge-level email verification before the request even "},{"id":"p20s5","text":"cessPolicy: 'emailOtp'`)**: edge-level email verification before the request even reaches the proxy."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"Recommendation: expose the public URL with **both** gates on. Disabling both means anyone holding th"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"e URL has full control of the harness (settings, credentials, directory picker) — only acceptable on"},{"id":"p21s3","text":"rol of the harness (settings, credentials, directory picker) — only acceptable on a trusted network."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"Local use (`http://127.0.0.1:3080`) bypasses the proxy entirely and is unaffected."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"## Prerequisites"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"- A profile with the web surface (`dsh web` / `--profile web`).
- **Tunnel token mode**: a tunnel to"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"ken from the Zero Trust dashboard, with a public hostname routing to `http://127.0.0.1:3091` (the lo"},{"id":"p24s3","text":"opback proxy port — routing to `3080` bypasses the access-token gate).
- **API token mode**: an API "},{"id":"p24s4","text":"token with the permissions above, plus a hostname whose DNS zone is on that account.
- Outbound netw"},{"id":"p24s5","text":"ork access to `github.com` on first connect (only to fetch `cloudflared`; it is then cached)."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"## Architecture"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"| Concern | Where | Mechanism |"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"| Provision `cloudflared` | `lib/cloudflared.js` | GitHub release download + `tar` extract + cache u"},{"id":"p27s2","text":"nder `$DSH_HOME/cloudflared` |
| Run/manage tunnel | `lib/index.js` | `node:child_process` spawn + `"},{"id":"p27s3","text":"ctx.effect` teardown |
| Cloudflare API | `lib/cfapi.js` | `cfd_tunnel` create + `configurations` in"},{"id":"p27s4","text":"gress + `dns_records` CNAME + Access app/policy |
| Loopback proxy | `lib/proxy.js` | Host rewrite t"},{"id":"p27s5","text":"o loopback + Origin drop + access-token gate (cookie / `?token=`) + WS forward — zero dependencies ("},{"id":"p27s6","text":"`node:http` + `node:net`, no http-proxy / DEP0060) |
| Dependencies | `package.json` | `schemastery`"},{"id":"p27s7","text":" as a leaf dependency; host seams (`dsh-settings`) as peerDependencies; `engines.node >= 20.3` |
| S"},{"id":"p27s8","text":"ecrets | `lib/index.js` | `ctx.credentials` (`CLOUDFLARE_API_TOKEN`, `CLOUDFLARE_TUNNEL_TOKEN`, `CLO"},{"id":"p27s9","text":"UDFLARE_TUNNEL_PROXY_TOKEN`) |
| Preferences | `lib/index.js` | `ctx.settings` namespace `cloudflare"},{"id":"p27s10","text":"-tunnel` |
| Client→Host RPC | both halves | `ctx.connection.rpc.handle('/cloudflare-tunnel', …)` / "},{"id":"p27s11","text":"`ctx.get('connection').rpc.call(…)` |
| Settings UI | `lib/client.js` | `ctx.slots.inject('settings."},{"id":"p27s12","text":"section', …)` + locale dictionaries |
| Bundle wiring | `cordis.patch.yml` + `package.json` `dsh` | "},{"id":"p27s13","text":"one insert row, auto-added to `dsh.profile.bundles` |"},{"id":"p28s1","text":"RPC endpoints on `/cloudflare-tunnel`: `status`, `start`, `stop`, `setProxyAuth`. `start` accepts an"},{"id":"p28s2","text":" `AbortSignal`, so cancelling from the UI aborts in-flight downloads and API setup."},{"id":"p29s1","text":"## Limitations"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"- Web-profile only (the node half waits for `connection`, `credentials`, `settings`, and `webServer`"},{"id":"p30s2","text":"; in headless/TUI it stays dormant).
- Process-local: the running tunnel does not survive a harness "},{"id":"p30s3","text":"restart, but the cached binary, the stored secrets and preferences do. The tunnel, ingress, and DNS "},{"id":"p30s4","text":"records persist on Cloudflare.
- The API token is used for Cloudflare API setup calls (tunnel/ingres"},{"id":"p30s5","text":"s/DNS/Access); the running `cloudflared` authenticates with the tunnel token, not the API token."}],"truncated":true}
